name: Stree Shakti Package for Women Entrepreneurs
description: Special bank credit package offering collateral concessions and 0.5% interest rate rebate for women entrepreneurs holding more than 50% financial ownership in small / micro business enterprises.
nodalAgency: Public Sector Banks / Ministry of Women and Child Development
targetAudience: Women-owned micro and small enterprises (>50% ownership by women)
requiredDocuments: Proof of Ownership (>50% share holding by woman entrepreneur)
